name: Regular City Council Meeting Agenda (Reorganization)
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this regular meeting of the City Council will be held via
  teleconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19)
  and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20.

  No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and
  offer public comment will be provided. Please listen to the meeting, which will be live
  streamed at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo.

  Public comment on agenda items is welcome and members of the public may submit
  written correspondence to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us to be read into the
  record for any item on which they would like to comment. Members of the public may
  also submit comments by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262, extension 200.
  Comment submitted before 5:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting will be read until the
  time limit of three minutes has been reached.

  All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote
  will be publicly reported.

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  (to be held during COVID-19 emergency)

  LOCATION:
  VARIOUS TELECONFERENCE LOCATIONS

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 14, 2020
  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

MEETING PROCEDURES

As a result of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, states of emergency have been
declared in the County of Los Angeles and the state of California. The President of the
United States has declared a federal emergency. At the direction of the Governor, starting
March 19, 2020, the entire state is subject to stay-at-home orders. These measures are
imposed to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19. To comply with these emergency
measures, the City Council meeting will be open and public but conducted via
teleconference only. This way the public, the staff, and the Council will not be physically
in the same place. The City is endeavoring to employ technology that will allow the public
to view the meeting live and participate.

Public comments may be submitted by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us, or by
voicemail to (562) 865-6262, extension 200. Public comments received by voicemail will
 be transcribed. Please submit email and voicemail public comments by 5:00 p.m. on the
date of the meeting to ensure that the comments are read into the record.

INVOCATION – ALI SAJJAD TAJ, CITY OF ARTESIA MAYOR

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – ALI SAJJAD TAJ, CITY OF ARTESIA MAYOR

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda and items listed under the heading “Reorganization Program.”
Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the
end of the meeting. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is prohibited
from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to
staff or to a subsequent meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or other
issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

REORGANIZATION PROGRAM

  1. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-2831, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, RECITING THE FACT OF
  THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON NOVEMBER 3, 2020, AND
  DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY
  LAW
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  2. SWEARING-IN OF NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS

  A. CITY CLERK TO ADMINISTER OATH OF OFFICE TO COUNCILMEMBER
  ELECT TONY LIMA

  B. CITY CLERKTO ADMINISTER OATH OF OFFICE TO COUNCILMEMBER
  ELECT MONICA MANALO

  3. SEATING OF NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS

  4. COMMENTS FROM INCOMING AND RE-ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS

  5. SELECTION OF MAYOR

  6. SELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM
   7. INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

This is the time for the public to address the City Council on any item of interest within the
subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council that could not be heard under public
comment section at the beginning of the meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for additional general comments, announcements, and requests of Staff
and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this
time.

  ADJOURNMENT TO
  ADJOURNED REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  OF DECEMBER 15, 2020 AT 7:00 P.M.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.
minutes_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 14, 2020
  7:00 P.M.
The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:20 p.m., on Monday,
December 14, 2020 at Various Teleconference Locations by Mayor Ali Taj. The Invocation was
presented by Councilmember Canales. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Councilmember
Ramoso.

Present:  Ali Taj, Mayor
  Rene Trevino, Mayor Pro Tem
  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember Elect – arrived at 7:36 p.m.
  Monica Manalo, Councilmember Elect

Also Present:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Hong Dao, Nguyen, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistant City Clerk

MEETING PROCEDURES

THE CITY CLERK READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS FOLLOWS:

To comply with these emergency measures, the City Council meeting will be open and public
but conducted via teleconference only. This way the public, the staff, and the Council will not be
physically in the same place. The City is endeavoring to employ technology that will allow the
public to view the meeting live and participate. Public comment must be submitted by email to
publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by voicemail to (562) 865-6262 ext. 200. Submissions
should be limited to 300 words or less and must be received prior to 5:00pm on the date of the
meeting.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO

  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Canales, Ramoso, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 4-0-0-1.

  1
 ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS

  The City Clerk presented the Announcement Regarding Public Comments, and reported
  that there were no public comments at this time.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Canales provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

  Mayor Taj provided comments.

REORGANIZATION PROGRAM

  1. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-2831, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, RECITING THE FACT OF THE GENERAL
  MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON NOVEMBER 3, 2020, AND DECLARING THE
  RESULTS AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY LAW

  MOTION MADE BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO TO ADOPT OF RESOLUTION NO.
  20-2831, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA,
  CALIFORNIA, RECITING THE FACT OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  HELD ON NOVEMBER 3, 2020, AND DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH
  OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY LAW

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO.

  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Canales, Ramoso, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima

  2. SWEARING-IN OF NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBER

  A. CITY CLERK TO ADMINISTER OATH OF OFFICE TO COUNCILMEMBER
  ELECT TONY LIMA

  Councilmember Elect Lima arrived at 7:36 p.m.

  City Clerk administered the Oath of Office to Councilmember Elect Lima.

  B. CITY CLERK TO ADMINISTER OATH OF OFFICE TO COUNCILMEMBER
  ELECT MONICA MANALO

  City Clerk administered the Oath of Office to Councilmember Elect Manalo.

  2
 3. SEATING OF NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS

  Councilmember Canales leaves meeting.

4. COMMENTS FROM INCOMING AND RE-ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Manalo provided comments.

5. SELECTION OF MAYOR

  Mayor Taj opened nomination period for Mayor Elect among Councilmembers.

  Councilmember Ramoso nominated Mayor Pro Tem Rene Trevino for Mayor Elect.

  Mayor Taj closed the nomination period for Mayor Elect among Councilmembers.

  MOTION BY MAYOR TAJ TO ELECT MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO AS MAYOR.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Manalo, Lima, Ramoso, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Mayor Pro Tem Trevino was elected Mayor without objection
  5-0-0-0.

6. SELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM

  Mayor Trevino opened nomination period for Mayor Pro Tem Elect among
  Councilmembers.

  Councilmember Taj nominated Councilmember Ramoso for Mayor Pro Tem Elect.

  Mayor Trevino closed the nomination period for Mayor Pro Tem Elect among
  Councilmembers.

  MOTION BY MAYOR TREVINO TO ELECT COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO AS MAYOR
  PRO TEM.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Manalo, Lima, Ramoso, Taj, Trevino
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Councilmember Ramoso was elected Mayor Pro Tem without
  objection 5-0-0-0.

7. INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

  3
   Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Trevino provided comments.

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

  There were no additional comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Manalo provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Trevino provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Trevino adjourned the meeting at 8:06pm.
